supersedes: configs/experiments/reward-contract-design-v2.json for the17panel65I55S semantic track; historical experiments unchanged

process.formula: sum_f cap_f / fixed_capacity_f * sum_j_in_panel mask_fj * correctness_fj
process.cross_budget: Only registered17panel schedule with capacity4perfamily. Other question budgets require separate preregistered contract; no implicit rescaling.
process.scope: Equal raw coefficient per predicate and same-input Final ranking margin, not equal positive/negative exposure, family totals, advantages, gradients or empirical benefit.
process.ragged_panels: Unused capacity remains unused. Every semantic predicate occurs once per complete17panel sweep at coefficient.025; no duplicated questions or label-dependent denominators.

sweep_totals.interpretation: Maximum equal-panel-mean coefficients when all labels admitted/correct. Different family sizes give different totals; preserve each-call cap0.1, do not claim full0.1 average per family.

ce.stage2: Final_CE + .025*sum_valid_I_present_CE + .025*sum_valid_S_present_CE; shared_decay_lambda; no cap8 polarity weighting inherited from Stage1
ce.balance: training_population_only_predeclared_outer_weight; report natural and weighted objectives separately
ce.ragged_panels: Same fixed capacity coefficients for Q_input and Q_credit; no missing-label or empty-slot transfer. This changes both arms equally relative to oldv2, so do not compare v2/v3 curves as reward-only effect.

algorithms.ppo_critic: joint_clipped_surrogate_with_pinned_verl_whitened_R_minus_V; unwhitened_return_for_critic; no additional normalization; behavior-batch scope in rl-baseline-design-v2
algorithms.grpo: standard_group_center_and_sample_std_plus_1e-6; process cap not preserved in gradient scale

registered_extension.caveat: For R in [0,1.2], sample_std<=1.2/sqrt(2)<1: this collapses to group-centered reward, not a novel stepwise method.
registered_extension.relation: group_centered_advantage=(G-1)/G * RLOO_advantage; compare with scaling disclosed

stepwise.shared_parameter_warning: zero independent process action credit does not mean no backbone gradient through process hidden positions
stepwise.grpo_warning: Fixed raw weights remove ragged denominator bias but do not control GRPO standardized gradient weight in Final-constant groups. Standard advantage definition unchanged; report group and gradient diagnostics.

task_resolution_migration.historical_values: Retained for provenance; do not inherit I_class menus/denominators/definitions as semantic I_present settings. No new runnable profile created.

semantic_redundancy_review.decision: Menuv3 has each predicate exactly once per complete sweep; semantic overlap still requires admitted-label audit. No sample-gold deduplication or hierarchy inference.
semantic_redundancy_review.scope: Exact fixed-answer arithmetic, not runtime integration or model effect
semantic_redundancy_review.limitation: Fixed coefficient does not solve duplicated semantic concepts; exact duplicate IDs are rejected by menu audit.
